name: Mikage Lizu
source:
"Hurry along, now. You know fully well that I detest waiting."

A domineering girl, much like a queen. All her words come across as cold and condescending, as though she were looking down upon you. She is highly temperamental, her emotions constantly fluctuating between extremes, and all her words are sharp as knives. She holds a great passion for the piano. Although she is best friends with [url=https://vndb.org/c155642]Sakuya[/url], she also loathes Sakuya greatly.

Flower: White Lily
Bloom Factor: [???]
Magic: [???]

[Translated by the [url=https://Acacia.wiki.gg/Liz_Mikage]Acacia Wiki[/url].]
[Description taken from the [url=https://https://mahoumura.com/]Official Site[/url].]
